bear_assumptions: EUR10.00 normalized forward adjusted EPS at 19x; data-centre systems growth normalizes, mix and input costs pressure margins, working capital stays elevated and acquisition-related net debt restrains the multiple.
base_assumptions: EUR10.00 normalized forward adjusted EPS at 24x; 10-13% organic revenue growth and operating leverage partly offset systems mix, working capital, Cognite funding and a premium starting valuation.
bull_assumptions: EUR10.65 normalized forward adjusted EPS at about 31x; data-centre demand converts broadly, Energy Management sustains strong margins, recurring software and services accelerate and acquisitions preserve per-share returns.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if price or stronger normalized earnings clear every expected, base, payoff and margin-of-safety gate after the AI-infrastructure-power relationship is accepted; downgrade if data-centre demand, backlog conversion, margins, cash conversion, leverage, acquisition returns or concentration deteriorate.
